requirement: A player should be able to control how sensitive the shooting/aiming is.

implementation.setting: Options > AIM SENSITIVITY, or [ and ] at any time while playing
implementation.range: 25% to 200% of the authored look rate, in 25/50/75/100/125/150/200 steps
implementation.applies_to: Mouse look and Z/X/T/V keyboard look through APiedmontExplorer::LookYaw/LookPitch
implementation.default: 100%, which is the 0.5 authored baseline tuned in build 098
implementation.feedback: HUD notice shows the new percentage for three seconds

signed_share_app.command: The Battle of ATL Mac Playtest 099.app -BattleAimAudit

scope_limits: The measured 8x ratio covers the look-input path both ways call into; engine mouse-axis injection is not exposed, so the mouse check confirms the axis binding plus the shared scaled handler.
Feel at each step still needs Elliott's hands-on judgement; the setting exists so that judgement is his, not a fixed number.
Notarization and Apple review are unchanged by this build.
